analysis.session_summary: Full day tape favored safe havens: DXY up 0.807%, SPX down 0.961%, VIX up 3.383%. CHF led with +0.759% strength while EUR lagged at -0.676%; USD closed at its best. The ISM miss at 54.5 vs 54.8 produced an inverted USD reaction (+0.102%), implying short-covering. EUR/USD fell 120.2 pips to 1.12186 and closed at 0.02 of its range.

themes.evidence: CHF strength +0.759%, USD/CHF -30.6 pips, EUR/CHF -134.8 pips
EUR strength -0.676%, EUR/USD -120.2 pips, EUR/GBP -40.1 pips

currency_drivers.USD: ISM miss inverted to USD strength, signaling short-covering; USD closed at session best.
currency_drivers.EUR: ECB Lagarde offered nothing; EUR fell to weakest major with no hawkish support.
currency_drivers.JPY: No Japanese data; yen surged on unconfirmed intervention headline before fading.
currency_drivers.GBP: BOE Bailey was muted; GBP led early then gave back 98% of gains.
currency_drivers.AUD: No Australian data; early gains faded with risk-off and USD strength.
currency_drivers.CAD: No domestic data; CAD firmed with Brent up 2.5% despite risk-off.
currency_drivers.CHF: SNB Schlegel speak drove CHF recovery after inline CPI dip; hawkish read.
currency_drivers.NZD: No New Zealand data; NZD attempt rejected, closing at session lows.

leg_notes.EUR/USD: EUR/USD printed three main legs—down 70.1, up 34.1, then down 85.6 pips—with the final leg dominated by EUR weakness and USD strength; SNB Schlegel added 14.7 pips (17% of final leg).

polarity_reads.read: A miss (54.5 vs 54.8) produced USD +0.102%, implying the market was positioned short dollars and covered on the disappointment; upward USD reaction is inconsistent with rate-cut pricing.
CHF firmed 0.078% with no forecast to score; the move implies markets read the speech as hawkish or as confirming SNB tolerance for CHF strength.
Inline 0.0% vs 0.0% initially left CHF weaker 0.064%, showing no data impetus; subsequent CHF recovery was not driven by CPI.
GBP basket moved -0.013%, inside noise; no hawkish signal, reinforcing GBP's inability to hold gains.
